headline: Forest edge Brentford 3-2 as Wood and Domínguez strike at City Ground
paragraphs: Nott'm Forest beat Brentford 3-2 at the City Ground after a volatile first half and a Chris Wood winner in the 66th minute. Wood opened the scoring in the 8th minute from Ola Aina's assist (xG 0.194), and Forest's xG of 3.33 against Brentford's 1.00 reflects the gap in chance quality across the match. Brentford hit back through Vitaly Janelt (26', xG 0.39, assisted by Mikkel Damsgaard) and Damsgaard himself (35', xG 0.436, assisted by Christian Nørgaard), the second of those swinging momentum to the visitors. Nicolás Domínguez levelled for Forest two minutes later (37', xG 0.449, assisted by Elliot Anderson).

Forest dominated the territorial battle: 55% possession, 67 field tilt and 66 control against Brentford's 45%, 33 and 51. They took 17 shots, 8 on target, to Brentford's 4 and 3. Pass accuracy was 81% for Forest and 78% for Brentford, but Damsgaard's 62% and Wood's 60% suggest the final third was contested more than the completion rates imply. Wood's two goals came from big chances at 6' (xG 0.267) and his 66th-minute finish (xG 0.183), while Ola Aina recorded two assists from a 100% pass accuracy and 34 duels won.

Brentford's game was undone by discipline and their own shot volume. Keane Lewis-Potter (1'), Nørgaard (66') and Michael Kayode (87') were booked, and Nørgaard's yellow came in the same minute as Forest's winner. Elliot Anderson had the final major chance at 86' (xG 0.288) but could not add to the scoreline. Chaos index finished at 27 with a tempo of 4.7 passes per minute, reflecting an open second half in which Forest held on for the three points.
